verdict.rationale: Zero ships a documented MCP server (zero-docs-1..17) exposing a broad set of email actions—labels, search, compose, drafts, send, delete, thread Q&A, web search—that mirror many core UI actions, and zero-probe-1 confirms this is an official first-party API surface. However there's no evidence of full parity: settings/account management, unified inbox provider configuration, and UI customization features are not exposed via the API, and no independent test confirms 1:1 coverage of all UI capabilities. Missing for 10: API coverage of account/provider settings, confirmation of complete feature parity beyond email actions, and independent hands-on validation of MCP completeness.
